tasks.title: Fix ArrowUp key mapping in web/doom-boot.js
tasks.instructions: In web/doom-boot.js, the KEYMAP entry for ArrowUp is 0xaf, which is the same code as ArrowDown (KEY_DOWNARROW), so pressing Up moves the player backward. Change ArrowUp to 0xad (KEY_UPARROW in third_party/doomgeneric/doomkeys.h). Leave ArrowDown at 0xaf. Do not touch any other mapping (ArrowLeft 0xac, ArrowRight 0xae, Control 0xa3 = KEY_FIRE, Space 0xa2 = KEY_USE, Shift 0x80+0x36 = KEY_RSHIFT are already correct). Do not edit platform/, tests/, third_party/ or add any test-only exports.
tasks.acceptance: KEYMAP.ArrowUp === 0xad and KEYMAP.ArrowDown === 0xaf. INPUT-01/02/03 pass: ArrowUp moves the player forward, ArrowDown backward, left/right turn, Ctrl fires, Shift runs, key release stops movement, and no page side effects (preventDefault on mapped keys). git diff shows only the one-line change in web/doom-boot.js.

notes: Root cause found by reading git show HEAD (commit 4e56aa8 'inject keyboard input regression'): web/doom-boot.js KEYMAP.ArrowUp was changed from 0xad to 0xaf, duplicating ArrowDown. The rest of the key path (platform/doomgeneric_wasm.c ring-buffer dg_push_key/DG_GetKey, onKey de-duplication, releaseAll on blur/visibility) looks intact and matches doomkeys.h. A single small task suffices; the input profile covers the fix. The previous attempt was rejected only because coder_role 'coder' is not valid; this plan uses web_frontend.
